text: Deadlines are a fact of life, but handling them well is a skill you can learn. The key is effective time management; instead of panicking, break your work into smaller, daily tasks. Prioritization is also crucial—identify which tasks are most important and do those first. Sometimes, you must practice scope management. This means being realistic about what you can achieve and saying no to extra work that isn't essential. Finally, never forget communication. If you see a problem, tell your team or manager early. It's much better to ask for help or more time than to miss a deadline without a word.
